title: A structural closure of growth-sector couplings between discrete gravity and cosmology
abstract: Tests three operator-level ways Energy-Flow Cosmology could couple to the linear growth equation: multiplicative Geff in the Poisson term, additive local friction, and additive non-local (memory) friction. Using DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic-chronometer H(z), fσ8, and EG data, it shows each class is either structurally excluded or degenerate with Ωm once geometry is locked, implying growth-only observables cannot discriminate this theory class and pointing to lensing/slip or cross-correlations as the next informative directions.
